title: Domestic warmth after an imperfect transition

captions.physics: Ending unnecessary domestic forms and procedures
captions.energy: Comparing the present with ideal futures

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its warmth when an ending permits care under present conditions instead of postponing comfort until the entire desired future picture is realised.
text: You can finish a domestic task that has lost its purpose and change the form of participation. Death in the physical position of Muladhara describes this ending. The Star in energy complicates it through an ideal future beside which the present seems insufficient. The Empress in emotions wants warmth and sufficient care. Transition can remove available comfort from home. Both released an earlier method, but new convenience supposedly remains inadequate until it belongs within a fully realised beautiful picture with no domestic questions left open.

For example, you abandon a large tea service and keep a few convenient cups. Simple tea seems a temporary compromise until ideal new crockery arrives. **Present care is no less real because a dream remains unfinished.** Convenience can be recognised and a calm meeting enjoyed at the table. An ending enables warmer life instead of making every reduction an empty space first requiring a perfect new object before either may feel sufficiently settled at home.

The difficulty is considering the available premature abandonment of something better. Comfort always lies after another purchase or alteration. Distinguishing hope from present need offers more dependable support: both can have space. Transition selects sufficient care now without proving an ending’s value through the immediate appearance of an entirely new, faultlessly suitable domestic routine. The dream can remain open while the cups already serve both.
